Package index

Main deconvolution function

Top-level function to deconvolve a matrix of bulk expression samples using any combination of deconvolution algorithms in parallel.

deconvolute_ratios()
Parallel deconvolution of a bulk expression matrix

DeCovarT algorithm

Covariance-aware optimisation of cellular ratios under a multivariate Gaussian convolution model.

Score equations and simplex maps

Analytic first- and second-order helpers for the unconstrained and ILR-constrained log-likelihood (Helmert basis; Jacobian / Hessian of the isometric logistic map; gradients and Hessians of ()). Additive log-ratio maps are kept for the vignette appendix. Documented for ? / source inspection; see also vignette("theory-decovart-generative-model").

helmert_basis()
Helmert contrast matrix for isometric log-ratio coordinates
isometric_logistic() isometric_log_ratio()
Isometric logistic transform (ILR coordinates to the simplex)
jacobian_isometric_logistic()
Jacobian of the isometric logistic map
hessian_isometric_logistic()
Hessian tensor of the isometric logistic map
starting_simplex()
Open-simplex start for ILR solvers
additive_logistic() additive_log_ratio()
Additive logistic transform (unconstrained coordinates to the simplex)
jacobian_additive_logistic()
Jacobian \(\mathbf{J}_{\boldsymbol{\psi}}\) of the additive logistic map
hessian_additive_logistic()
Second derivatives (Hessian tensor) of the additive logistic map
gradient_loglik_unconstrained()
Gradient \(\nabla_{\boldsymbol{p}}\ell\) of the unconstrained log-likelihood
hessian_loglik_unconstrained()
Hessian \(\mathbf{H}\) of the unconstrained log-likelihood
gradient_loglik_constrained()
Constrained gradient via the chain rule
hessian_loglik_constrained()
Constrained Hessian of \(\ell\circ\boldsymbol{\psi}\)

Core optimiser

Marquardt–Levenberg deconvolution (exported entry point). Related first- and second-order variants live in R/03_03_DeCovarT_estimate_ratios_frequentist.R. The S3 model wrapper is fit_decovart().

deconvolute_ratios_cibersort() deconvolute_ratios_rlm() deconvolute_ratios_nnls() deconvolute_ratios_deconrnaseq() deconvolute_ratios_Marquardt_Levenberg() deconvolute_ratios_simulated_annealing() deconvolute_ratios_L_BFGS_B() deconvolute_ratios_Newton_Raphson() deconvolute_ratios_gradient_descent()
DeCovarT MLE of cellular proportions for one bulk sample
fit_decovart() print(<decovart_fit>) summary(<decovart_fit>) print(<summary.decovart_fit>) coef(<decovart_fit>) fitted(<decovart_fit>) residuals(<decovart_fit>) vcov(<decovart_fit>) nobs(<decovart_fit>) confint(<decovart_fit>) plot(<decovart_fit>)
Fit the DeCovarT Gaussian-convolution model

Fixed-covariance GLS competitor

MASS::lm.gls() wrapper with a known residual covariance (fixed_gls_covariance() at a declared composition).

deconvolute_ratios_gls()
Generalised least squares with a fixed residual covariance
fixed_gls_covariance()
Fixed residual covariance for a GLS competitor

Structure-aware covariance backends

Factorise (()=_j p_j^2 _j) by exploiting declared covariance structure (block, band, sparse, diagonal-plus-low-rank) instead of a dense Cholesky. Operators return the log-determinant and solves without a materialised precision. See vignette("theory-decovart-generative-model").

new_decovart_covariance() print(<decovart_covariance>)
Structure-aware covariance backend for \(\boldsymbol{\Sigma}(\boldsymbol{p})\)
covariance_structure_from_graph_model()
Recommend a covariance backend from a network topology
sigma_logdet()
Log-determinant of \(\boldsymbol{\Sigma}(\boldsymbol{p})\)
sigma_solve()
Precision solve \(\boldsymbol{\Sigma}(\boldsymbol{p})^{-1}\mathbf{B}\)
sigma_quadform()
Mahalanobis quadratic form \(\mathbf{r}^{\mathsf{T}}\boldsymbol{\Sigma}(\boldsymbol{p})^{-1}\mathbf{r}\)
sigma_trace_precision_times()
Trace of the precision times a matrix, \(\operatorname{tr}(\boldsymbol{\Theta}(\boldsymbol{p})\mathbf{S})\)

Fisher information and Wald intervals

Expected Fisher information of unconstrained proportions and ILR delta-method covariance used by vcov() / confint() on decovart_fit objects (see fit_decovart). vcov_alr_delta() is retained for reference-invariance checks.

expected_fisher_unconstrained()
Expected Fisher information of unconstrained \(\boldsymbol{p}\)
vcov_ilr_delta()
Cramer–Rao / ILR delta-method covariance of \(\hat{\boldsymbol{p}}\)
vcov_alr_delta()
Cramer–Rao / ALR delta-method covariance of \(\hat{\boldsymbol{p}}\)

Likelihood-ratio and boundary inference

Profile likelihood, likelihood-ratio tests with chi-bar-square (Chernoff / Self–Liang) calibration on simplex faces, parametric bootstrap, reference-sample bootstrap (donors, cells, or Dirichlet compositions), and the boundary / multimodality diagnostics that a bare convergence code cannot provide. See vignette("theory-DeCovarT-MLE-properties").

restricted_mle_decovart()
Restricted maximum likelihood with fixed cellular ratios
profile_loglik_decovart()
Profile log-likelihood of one cellular ratio
lrt_decovart()
Likelihood-ratio test for cellular ratios
confint_profile_decovart()
Profile-likelihood confidence intervals for cellular ratios
chi_bar_square_pvalue()
Chi-bar-square tail probability for boundary likelihood-ratio tests
bootstrap_decovart()
Parametric bootstrap for DeCovarT proportions and boundary tests
reference_bootstrap_decovart()
Reference-based bootstrap for signature and composition uncertainty
equivariance_check_decovart()
Permutation-equivariance check for a labelled reference
boundary_diagnostics()
Boundary and stationarity diagnostics for one DeCovarT fit
multistart_decovart()
Refit DeCovarT from several random starts to probe multimodality
